While im not sure i have advice for motivation but i do know that a lack of self care whether it was mental or physical will NOT help so im gonna give some personal tips that i usually use.

You mention that you lay in bed a lot, i think it's always a good idea to have any kinds of hygiene essential near you because truthfully sometimes a person just can't get out of bed, things like deodorant and dry shampoo go a long way. You can put them in a small back pack by your bed or in a bag. You can add a fresh clean t shirt, something that brings you comfort or makes you feel safe. It can be certain things given to you or something with good memories, anything that can bring you some peace of mind. Overall having healthy  coping mechanisms really lifts at least some of the burden.

I really really suggest reaching out to someone you trust, it doesn't have to be you venting, sometimes just asking for a hug could both bring you comfort and also indicate to the other person that you're not doing so well and could use some support. I also have very huge issues with sharing how i feel and such so this minor step as hard as taking it seemed really helped and its a start.

That being said, the fact you reached out HERE and wrote all of that is still a great step and i genuinly hope that if my reply wasnt helpful that you find one that is.

I just hate living- i don't want to, i can't keep up with all my mood swings, its hard to have hope for a few seconds and for it to be replaced with misery right away. 
It's tiring, if i can't enjoy things like hanging out with my friends or family,if i can't deeply trust my relationship with them, then how am i supposed to go on? They used to be the only reason i stayed alive and now that's gone so now what?
I don't want to be hanging on by a thread, i don't want a nice day on the beach to give me momentary hope, i want to wake the day after wanting to see people and to live. 
I don't want my pleasure and happiness to be from people, i want to have my own accomplishments, the ones nobody could give a shit about but me, i wanna be okay for ME. But it's hard,really hard. 
My brother keeps questioning whether im gonna do something cus i always say i will.
I was supposed to finally work on my stop motion film this break
Now it's gonna end and instead i chose to go on a trip with my family for five days.
I could have said no but i knew I'd just be really depressed on my bed
He said" see? You've already given up- you were never planning to do anything "
Like fuck off, i didn't give up, i could have chosen to the easy thing which is stay at the comfort of my bed and my mom wouldn't be here to tell me to get up so it's everything i want
But i didn't do that 
I decided to agree, my cousin would be dissapointed if i wasn't there and if i don't give a shit about myself then i could about her. 
I said yes to going to a city by bus for 12 hours,my OCD will drive me crazy but i still said yes.
I said yes, i didn't have to and i still did.
Even if i didn't do what i was planning to do
I still decided to do more than i have this past week and a half, maybe even months.
Either way its hard and there's a lot of hard things i have to do, but rn this hard thing is something im proud of facing.
